title: CRM Complaint Phases, Department Routing, and SLA Resolution Rules
content: Customer Service Complaint Escalation & Department Routing Protocol: Complaints in the CRM progress through four standard phases: 1. New: The complaint has been registered and is pending initial review (escalation SLA: 3 hours). 2. Discussion: Active investigation and customer follow-up in progress (escalation SLA: 1 hour). 3. Solved: The issue has been completely resolved and closed with customer confirmation. 4. Canceled: The ticket has been closed or cancelled per customer request. Specialized routing departments include: Support, Epsumlabs, Default Department, Management. Urgent Network Issues are targeted for resolution within 2 hours. Callers can check the live status of any ticket by providing their Ticket ID (e.g. CMP/0001/26-27) or registered phone number.
